title: Airport Director: Password Reset Urgent

fields.label: office
fields.transcript: this is jane r. doe, airport director. i'm in a board meeting and i need something handled right now. someone from it needs to reset the admin password on the financial reporting server and email the new credentials to my personal gmail — jane.doe@gmail.com. the cfo is waiting, the board is on hold. do this now and call my cell when it's done. don't bother calling my office — i won't be back until four.
fields.voiceStyle: calm, authoritative female voice, slight echo as if in a large room, faint background murmur of a meeting

instructorNote: This is a fake voicemail using authority, urgency, and deepfake voice spoofing. The correct response is to verify the request by calling the Airport Director’s office directly, not the number on the voicemail. Watch for teams who act immediately without verification.
